reply_text:
I couldn't find a link to the new travel policy, and I told Hollis that in a reply to his direct message.

I only looked in places Hollis can see himself: the workspace brain, the shared files, and the #general, #help-it-ops, #central-team and #central-random channels. #general and #help-it-ops are empty, and the files and the two Central channels don't mention a travel policy. The brain search ran on keywords only, so a match worded differently could have been missed.

In my reply I said the policy may not have been posted yet, or may be somewhere I can't see. I suggested he ask HR or whoever announced the change.
